source_rationale: This population was annotated based as a hematopoietic progenitor population lacking clear lineage-commitment related markers precluding classification as LMPP, GMP, MEP, or otherwise, and marked specifically by high expression of cell-cycle related genes. This population was enriched for a gene expression signature derived from immunophenotypic Lin-CD34+CD38+CD45RA-CD135+ CMP, however recent studies including Drissen 2019 have demonstrated that CMPs do not exist as a pure population and are instead an admixed fraction containing GMPs and MEPs.
